name: Automator for PayPal
author: knitpay

sections.description:
Automator for PayPal is a powerful addon that connects PayPal with automation tools like Uncanny Automator. This plugin allows you to automate tasks triggered by PayPal payment events, such as storing payment details in an Excel sheet, sending notifications, or performing other custom actions.

Features:
– Seamless integration with Uncanny Automator.
– Automate tasks triggered by PayPal payment captures.
– Extendable for use with other automation tools. Support for more tools will be added soon.

This plugin acts as an addon and requires an automation tool like Uncanny Automator to function.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/automator-for-paypal directory, or install the plugin through the WordPress plugins screen directly.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress.
  3. Ensure you have an automation tool like Uncanny Automator installed and configured.
  4. Start creating automation recipes using PayPal payment events.
sections.faq:
Does this plugin work without an automation tool?

No, this plugin is an addon and requires an automation tool like Uncanny Automator to function.

What PHP version is required?

This plugin requires PHP 7.3 or higher.
sections.changelog:

  • Initial release.
  • Integration with Uncanny Automator for PayPal payment events.
